catalog.name: Outdoor Skills Courses
catalog.description: Multi-week courses taught by Harbor & Pine guides at the Portland store and on the trail.

courses.name: Map And Compass Navigation
courses.description: Four evening classes and a field day on reading contour lines, taking bearings and planning a route without a phone.
courses.summary: Read a map, take a bearing and plan a route.

courses.name: Wilderness First Aid
courses.description: Two days of patient assessment, splinting and evacuation decisions.

courses.name: Winter Camping Foundations
courses.description: Six sessions on layering, snow shelters, stove safety and sleeping warm, ending with an overnight in the White Mountains.
courses.summary: Layering, shelters and sleeping warm in snow.

courses.name: Backcountry Cooking
courses.description: Plan, pack and cook three days of meals on one stove.
